title: Evidence-driven autonomy and uncertain payment effects
summary: Partition execution evidence by tenant, deduplicate receipts, and retain uncertain payment reservations until authoritative closure.
reusable_steps: Partition execution evidence by tenant, deduplicate receipts, and retain uncertain payment reservations until authoritative closure
expected_outcome: Autonomy promotion must use actual successful execution receipts with stable identity, not approval attempts or an allowed gate verdict. Partition evidence and overrides by protected tenant scope and revalidate current policy on every application. Invalid settings and corrupt evidence never relax authority. A payment needs a durable immutable business identity before reservation and submission; unknown or partial outcomes cannot be retried or credited as nonexecution. Only authoritative full compensation or permanent execution closure releases the original budget reservation. Keep provider-specific refund authority separate from read-only reconciliation.
